Noah R: Quick wrap from the cache-eviction PM — need owners for the follow-ups: nightly regression gate, incident-derived promptset, short CI cold-cache smoke, and a 30-min rehearsal. Dates and PRs please.
Sofia M: I can pick up nightly regression harness (cold-cache pressure + TTL drift). Will add a gate and auto-ticket lambda. PR target: Thu EOD.
Elliot J: I will curate the promptset from the incident transcript. Plan: 12 canonical prompts + 6 edge-cases (truncation/hallucination), golden outputs, and a tiny scorer. ETA: next Tue.
Priya S: I'll add the CI smoke job and a teardown/verify step. Will ensure it runs against staging-routing and uploads metrics artifact. PR tomorrow morning.
Noah R: Can we also include a short automatic gate: if eviction_rate > 0.025 for 2 consecutive runs -> open Jira and @oncall and mark as blocker.
Sofia M: Yep. Gate: run 5m with 50k keys, compute eviction_rate, fail if >0.02. If it fails twice -> lambda will create Jira and post in #incidents.
Elliot J: Promptset scoring: mark 4 prompts as 'blocking' (exact-match) and the rest fuzzy (Jaccard > 0.7). I will include expected JSON shapes and quick playback scripts for the drill.
Priya S: CI snippet I will add to infra:
```yaml
jobs:
  kv_cold_smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./tests/kv_cold_smoke.sh --keys 50000 --duration 240
      - run: ./tools/check_eviction.sh --threshold 0.025
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: eviction-artifact
          path: metrics/evict.json
```
